predictions.selection_reason: user-controlled path -> lstat call -> potential symlink or path traversal
predictions.source_summary: Path originates from listDirectory(".") after chdir("/tmp") in sandbox environment. Entries are directory names filtered to exclude "." and "..".
predictions.sink_summary: lstat() follows symlinks to get file status, used to decide if file should be added to zip archive or if directory should be recursively enumerated.
predictions.guard_summary: listDirectory filters "." and "..". Paths containing newlines are filtered. Sandbox uses namespace isolation with pivot_root and read-only mounts. No symlink traversal protection in lstat call.
predictions.risk_pattern: lstat on directory entries follows symlinks without validation, potentially allowing stat of files outside intended backup scope or inclusion of external files via symlinks.
predictions.context_summary: In backup mode (not restore), enumerates current directory ("/tmp" after pivot_root) recursively, calling lstat on each entry to determine file type for zip archive creation.
unresolved_facts: Whether symlinks can exist in mounted directories at /tmp
Exact directory structure at /tmp during backup execution
If backup should be from /tmp or from grain data directory /tmp/tmp/data

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
top_sast_rules.description: File access follows a symlink, hardlink, or shortcut to an unintended resource.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-59 symlink hardlink link-following symbolic-link file-link archive-extraction path-resolution file-overwrite race filesystem
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject unsafe links and verify resolved file targets before access.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a potentially malicious tarball using `shutil.unpack_archive()` without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can cause files outside the destination directory to be overwritten. More precisely, if the tarball comes from a user controlled location either a remote one or cli argument.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement path validation using canonical paths. Reject paths containing '../' or similar traversal sequences.
